Theorem
[nonnegative curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0043, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0044 ↗ thm:chow-ii-system-wmp ↗ cor:chow-ii-nonnegative-tensor-cone 1. ch10:10.14\group Ricci-flow applications

For a closed Ricci flow, nonnegative curvature operator is preserved.
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:chow-ii-system-wmp ↗ cor:chow-ii-nonnegative-tensor-cone After Uhlenbeck’s bundle identification, the curvature operator obeys

\[ \partial _t\Rm =\Delta \Rm +\Rm ^2+\Rm ^\# . \]

If $\Rm \ge 0$, then both quadratic terms are nonnegative on every null eigenvector, so the associated ODE preserves the nonnegative cone. Apply the system principle.

□
